title: Petition of Energy Answers Corporation, Inc. respectfully requests that the Department of Public Utilities review the actions of Western Massachusetts Electric Company (WMECo in connection with WMECo's refusal to negotiate and execute a Standard B power purchase agreement with EAC for the sale of electric capacity and energy from EAC's Qualifying Facility in the WMECo service territory, as required by the Department's regulations at 220 C.M.R. 10.07(1) and PURPA.
